entries.german: Pfalzgraf Ruprecht d. Ä. verpfändet seine Burg Minneberg um 2.810 Gulden an Konrad von Rosenberg und dessen Ehefrau Margarethe von Hirschhorn.
entries.english: Palatine Count Rupert the Elder pledges his castle Minneburg for 2,810 gulden to Konrad von Rosenberg and his wife Margaretha von Hirschhorn.

facts.content: received Minneburg Castle and its appurtenances in pledge from Count Palatine Ruprecht der Ältere together with his wife Margarethe von Hirschhorn.
